open_points.subject: Operator access to instance configuration and secrets
open_points.text: “An agent works with the owner's own access to Registry's host and could read the store and the instance's configuration, service tokens included” contradicts “configuration is set on its host, readable only by the owner and the Registry process.”
open_points.question: Is an operator agent authorized and technically able to read Registry configuration and service tokens, or must configuration access be restricted to the human owner and Registry process?
options: The agent counts as the owner and may read all configuration and secrets
The agent may access the host but must not be able to read Registry configuration or secrets
Only some operator forms may read configuration, and those forms must be named
open_points.default_guess: Treat an operator agent using the owner's host access as the owner for filesystem access, so it can read the configuration and secrets.
